linkedin:
Only 23% of the 4,441 remote jobs on Loker Dollar actually show a pay figure. Here's what the data says.

We analyzed our live board of USD-paying remote roles for Indonesians (data as of Oct 14, 2026). Of the 4,441 active listings, exactly 1,000 (23%) disclose a salary or hourly rate; the other 3,441 (77%) keep compensation private.

Key numbers:
- 2,753 listings (~62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world.
- Communication is the most requested skill (1,662 listings, 39% of the 4,282 analyzed).
- AI is now a listed prerequisite in 517 listings (12%), one of the fastest-growing categories.
- Leadership appears in 416 listings (10%).
- The board draws from 1,560 distinct companies, including Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether.
- Only one listing disclosed a rate: Neo Financial's remote bilingual client services at $5 USD/hour.

The takeaway isn't that hidden pay means low wages. Many employers expect candidates to negotiate. What matters is that roughly two-thirds of this market genuinely supports location-independent work.

Browse the live board and filter for worldwide remote roles to apply before they close.
